page: Microsoft Azure E32ns_v6 is a memory-optimized instance running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the server features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The compute configuration consists of 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading, providing 32 vCPUs. Memory capacity stands at 256 GB of RAM, yielding an allocation of 8 GB per vCPU, supported by 260 MB of L3 cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 48 KB of L1 data cache per core. The processor includes hardware acceleration extensions such as AVX-512, Intel AMX (tile and int8), and cryptographic instruction sets like AES and SHA-NI.

Benchmark measurements indicate reliable multi-threaded throughput and memory capabilities. The instance achieved 192.86 GB/s in uncached large-block read memory bandwidth, placing it in the upper quartile of evaluated machines. Compute operations show balanced characteristics, with stress-ng recording 1,933.39 on single-core and 31,368.89 on multi-core tests. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reached 205.46 GB/s, and PassMark physics scored 6,703.98, both ranking in the top 25 percent. In model inference tests, the platform recorded 381.68 tokens per second on small 135M model generation and 200.75 tokens per second on medium 7B model prompt processing, though large-parameter text generation dropped to 2.56 tokens per second.

The E32ns_v6 does not include onboard local storage or dedicated GPU accelerators, requiring storage persistence and secondary IOPS to be handled entirely through external network-attached volumes. Network throughput supports static web serving transfers up to 56.03 GB/s, while Redis SET performance yielded 40.94 million operations per second. The instance delivers solid resource density for RAM-heavy computing without the cost overhead of attached physical accelerators. This profile makes the instance well suited for memory-bound relational databases, large-scale Redis or Memcached clusters, data pipeline transformations, and enterprise application services.
description: Microsoft Azure E32ns_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 architecture, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at 4.2 GHz across 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs, backed by 260 MB of L3 cache and support for AMX and AVX-512 instruction sets. Equipped with 256 GB of system RAM, it maintains an 8 GB per vCPU allocation, achieving strong uncached read memory bandwidth of 192.86 GB/s. The instance includes no bundled local storage and no dedicated hardware GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage options. Benchmark testing shows strong multi-threaded bzip3 decompression throughput of 205.46 GB/s and static web serving speeds of 56.03 GB/s, alongside average multi-core CPU and Redis operational scores. This hardware profile provides a cost-effective, high-density memory footprint suited for large in-memory databases, memory-bound caching systems, enterprise application backends, and data processing pipelines.
